# lago_wallet (Resource)

Manages a Lago prepaid wallet for a customer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lago = {
      source  = "registry.opentofu.org/rpcpool/lago"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "lago" {
  api_endpoint = var.lago_api_endpoint
  api_key      = var.lago_api_key
}

resource "lago_customer" "acme" {
  external_id = "acme-corp-001"
  name        = "Acme Corp"
  email       = "billing@acme.example.com"
}

resource "lago_wallet" "acme_credits" {
  external_customer_id = lago_customer.acme.external_id
  name                 = "Acme Prepaid Credits"
  currency             = "USD"
  rate_amount          = "1.0"

  # Credits purchased and granted at creation time.
  # These fields are write-only and are not returned by the API.
  paid_credits    = "500.0"
  granted_credits = "50.0"

  invoice_requires_successful_payment = false

  # Optional: auto-top-up the wallet every month.
  recurring_transaction_rules = [
    {
      interval        = "monthly"
      method          = "fixed"
      trigger         = "interval"
      paid_credits    = "100.0"
      granted_credits = "10.0"
    }
  ]
}

variable "lago_api_endpoint" {
  type = string
}

variable "lago_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `currency` (String) Currency of the wallet (e.g. `USD`). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `external_customer_id` (String) External identifier of the customer who owns this wallet. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `rate_amount` (String) Credit-to-currency conversion rate expressed as a decimal string (e.g. `"1.0"`).

### Optional

- `expiration_at` (String) Wallet expiration date and time (RFC3339). When set, the wallet will expire at this date.
- `granted_credits` (String) Number of free credits granted on create/top-up. Write-only — not returned by the API after creation.
- `invoice_requires_successful_payment` (Boolean) When `true`, invoices using wallet credits are only finalized after successful payment.
- `name` (String) Display name for the wallet.
- `paid_credits` (String) Number of credits purchased on create/top-up. Write-only — not returned by the API after creation.
- `recurring_transaction_rules` (Attributes List) List of rules that automatically top up the wallet on a schedule or threshold. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recurring_transaction_rules))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Wallet creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `credits_balance` (String) Current credit balance of the wallet.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID, set to the wallet Lago UUID.
- `lago_id` (String) Lago internal UUID for the wallet.
- `status` (String) Current status of the wallet (`active`, `terminated`).

<a id="nestedatt--recurring_transaction_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recurring_transaction_rules`

Optional:

- `expiration_at` (String) Expiration date and time for the recurring rule (RFC3339).
- `granted_credits` (String) Number of free credits to grant on each top-up.
- `interval` (String) Top-up interval. Allowed values: `weekly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `yearly`.
- `invoice_requires_successful_payment` (Boolean) When `true`, invoices for this rule's top-up are only finalized after successful payment.
- `lago_id` (String) Lago UUID for this recurring transaction rule. Required when updating an existing rule.
- `method` (String) Top-up method. Allowed values: `fixed`, `target`.
- `paid_credits` (String) Number of paid credits to add on each top-up.
- `started_at` (String) Start date and time for the recurring rule (RFC3339).
- `threshold_credits` (String) Credit balance threshold that triggers a top-up when the `trigger` is `threshold`.
- `trigger` (String) What triggers the top-up. Allowed values: `interval`, `threshold`.
